title.value: CLIP-Mesh: Generating textured meshes from text using pretrained image-text models
title.justification: The paper focuses on a method called CLIP-Mesh for generating 3D models from text prompts using pretrained image-text models.
title.quote: We present a technique for zero-shot generation of a 3D model using only a target text prompt.

extractions.description: The paper introduces a method named CLIP-Mesh that allows for the generation of 3D meshes from text prompts. Leveraging a pretrained CLIP model, the technique optimizes mesh parameters to create shapes and textures that correspond to the input text without requiring 3D supervision. It introduces constraints and techniques to ensure plausible mesh generation and to enhance the integration with existing software.

primary_category.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on generating 3D meshes from text prompts for applications in gaming, virtual reality, and multimedia, which does not directly align with the eco-responsible categories defined.
primary_category.quote: Gaming, virtual reality, films and other multimedia experiences rely on the use of 3D models.

secondary_categories.justification: The content and methodology described in the paper do not directly relate to any identifiable secondary eco-responsible categories.
secondary_categories.quote: While there are various methods of representing these models, many existing games and modeling software use 3D assets consisting of a polygonal mesh coupled with texture and normal maps.

primary_sub_category.justification: The sub-categories provided do not include relevant topics that align with the generation of 3D models from text prompts as presented in this paper.
primary_sub_category.quote: The ideal scenario would be a technique where a user can generate any arbitrary 3D shape based on only an abstract text description of the object.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: No secondary sub-categories align with the research content or contributions of this paper in the context of eco-responsible topics.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: This would greatly increase the use and accessibility of developing 3D assets.

applications.value: 3D model generation from text for gaming and multimedia
applications.justification: The paper focuses on generating 3D models that can be deployed in games or multimedia applications, enhancing creativity and development efficiency.
applications.quote: This would greatly increase the use and accessibility of developing 3D assets.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper's focus on generating 3D models from text prompts suggests a new category is more appropriate for its content and contributions.
new_primary_category.quote: A technique for zero-shot generation of a 3D model using only a target text prompt.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The sub-category reflects the paper's aim to facilitate easier and more accessible 3D asset creation for use in gaming and multimedia contexts.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: The ideal scenario would be a technique where a user can generate any arbitrary 3D shape...this would easily facilitate integration with a large suite of existing game engines and software that use 3D meshes as primitives.
